name: Resonaut
summary: Resonaut is a highly customizable VR music visualizer. Play your own music files (all common types supported), tune in to 60,000+ internet radio stations, or stream from a media server on your home network, and watch 20+ visuals react to every beat, build and drop. Fly through fractals, drift among glowing jellyfish, stand on a moonlit shore as waves crash on the beat. Pick from 100+ looks, tweak any of them live and save your own. Lying-down mode, sleep timer and comfort options included.
